scope: RunCycle procedural puppet (Phase 1 constrained rig), frames 0..93; cel selection monotonicity covered by remotion/test/cels.test.ts; solver edge cases by test/ik.test.ts + reports/ik-validation.json

checks.name: deterministic SSR: same frame -> identical SVG (94 frames x2)
out-of-order frame requests -> identical SVG (72,0,45,12,93,25 twice, interleaved)
no NaN/Infinity/undefined; shadow+scarf+body present every frame
all joint coordinates finite and inside 1920x1080
solved bone lengths within ±0.5 px of configured rig lengths (94 frames x 8 bones)
IK end-effector residual <= 1 px for reachable targets; clamped targets reported
knee/elbow bend side stable and equal to rig hint (no flips incl. 25->26 wrap)
foot artwork length constant at rig.footLen=87.3 px (geometry, not a bone)
joint motion is smooth at the wrap (accel 286.5px <= 1.5 x p95 307.0px)
no one-frame pop at 26-frame wrap (joint delta 13.7px <= 1.5 x p95 295.2px)
no pixel pop at wrap (MAD 1.36 <= 1.5 x p95 5.41)
character visible (not blank) in every rasterized frame

midDeviationFromRawTargets.note: Expected nonzero: raw knee/elbow readings are noisy hand measurements (hip->knee varies 1.958x). The solver prioritizes end-effector accuracy + fixed bone lengths. Per-frame values below — never hidden.

segmentLengthStatsNote: SOLVED joints (what renders). Constrained bones have ratio ~1.000 by construction; ankle->toe is constant foot artwork. The historical unconstrained variation is preserved below and in reports/baseline/.

segmentLengthOrigin.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (not a gate since Phase 1). Three levels of the RAW unconstrained track, measured separately: rawMeasuredKeys (7 hand-measured poses per leg, exported read-only by keys.ts) -> storedTrack (26-sample LEG_CYCLE after build-time Catmull-Rom) -> interpolatedFrames (all 94). interpolationOvershoot = interpolated max / stored max. The constrained solver absorbs this noise without stretching bones.

historicalBaseline.replacedBy: per-bone configured-length error ±0.5 px + IK residual + bend stability (master plan §9.7)

notPresent_futureWork: true IK stance-locking (Phase 2 — not implemented yet)
measured foot-contact solver / verified contact track (Phase 2 — baseline candidates are UNCERTAIN)
cohesive limb/torso/foot silhouettes + deterministic scarf chain (Phase 3)
